description: 한국전자통신연구원_위키백과 QA API [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전자통신연구원. 자연어로 기술된 질문의 의미를 분석하여, 위키백과 문서에서 정답과 신뢰도 및 검색 단락을 추론하여 제공하는 API 입니다. 위키백과 QA는 질문에서 물어보고자 하는 대상의 정의와 속성에 대해 답을 제공할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 인물, 장소, 작품 등 다양한 단답형 정답을 묻는 질문에도 답을 할 수 있습니다... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국전자통신연구원. Its tags are 질의응답, 언어처리, 언어분석, 과학기술. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-07-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
